error[ZBX-E0571]: workforce pools are not supported
  cause  /home/ci/gcp.json names a workforce pool; zbx supports workload
         identity pools only
  var    GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS
  fix    use a workload identity pool's provider as the audience
  more   zbx explain E0571
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigbox/errors/E0571.html
